test_Lambda_bijector_event_shape: test the Lambda bijector event_shape against TFP Tanh bijector for 1d and 2d normal distributions
test_Lambda_bijector_log_prob: test the Lambda bijector log_prob computation against TFP TransformedDistribution for various normal distributions
test_Lambda_bijector_sample_shape: test the Lambda bijector sample shape correctness across multiple sample shapes and base distributions
test_Lambda_bijector_log_dets: test the Lambda bijector forward and inverse log determinant jacobian against TFP bijectors
test_Lambda_bijector_jittable: test that the Lambda bijector forward call is JAX JIT compilable with a simple identity lambda
